reason: I'm home with the kids all week and always need somewhere indoors to go, so if it's close and clean I'd be there often enough that $12 drop-ins add up. I'd probably try a couple of drop-ins first and join if my kid actually settles in.
objection: I'll still be chasing my kid, so I won't really get to sit and drink coffee. I'm paying $59 a month for a place that may only work for one of my kids' ages, and I haven't seen it yet.
would_change_my_mind: A free or cheap trial visit, or a month-to-month membership I can cancel anytime, so I'm not stuck if my kid hates it.
